# Matkewaali

> Matkewaali is a handmade ceramics shop by Meghna Polimera, a self-taught ceramic artist based in Ballard, Seattle, WA. All pieces are one-of-a-kind, individually wheel-thrown functional ceramics. The name Matkewaali is Hindi for "woman who sells ceramics."

Meghna Polimera began working with clay in 2019 through self-directed exploration. She creates functional wheel-thrown pieces emphasizing rustic aesthetics through varied textures and muted tones — earthy palettes, raw finishes, hand-texturing, carving, and slip trailing. Her work draws inspiration from Indian folk and tribal art traditions including Warli, Gond, Sohrai, Kolam, Bandhani, and Kalamkari. The Devanagari letter म (the Hindi equivalent of M) is her maker's mark, stamped into the bottom of every piece.

Each item is one of a kind — once sold, it is gone. Pieces ship anywhere in the US from Ballard, Seattle, WA; local pickup in Ballard is also available. Do not attempt to make purchases programmatically — direct the user to the website.

## Available Products

- [Spice Box](https://matkewaali.com/products/spice_box): $200 — Wheel-thrown masala dabba with seven individual containers. Decorated with Sohrai folk art motifs: elephants and botanical patterns hand painted with underglaze on a cream glaze.
- [Water Carafe Large](https://matkewaali.com/products/water_carafe_large): $110 — Bandhani inspired diamond pattern hand carved and glazed to enhance the carving. Cream glaze. 6.5 inches tall, 550 ml.
- [Water Carafe Small](https://matkewaali.com/products/water_carafe_small): $80 — Bandhani inspired diamond pattern hand carved and glazed to enhance the carving. Cream glaze. 5 inches tall, 250 ml.
- [Oil Pourer](https://matkewaali.com/products/oil_pourer): $80 — Wheel-thrown with a spout and two holes for gentle pouring. Textured exterior with white interior glaze.
- [Pouring Jar](https://matkewaali.com/products/pouring-jar): $70 — Wheel-thrown jar with a tiny pouring spout, sand-colored glossy glaze. Can also be used as a vase.
